reason: OpenCode with the local Qwen3.8 27B takes about 7 minutes per editing attempt on the host (Apple M3 Max, 48 GB), with the GPU fully loaded; five repeats would be 15-20 hours of that.
approved: Dmitry, 2026-10-02, while the OpenCode pilot was 15 of 30 attempts in and before any of its outputs was evaluated.
rule: opencode-qwen is captured once (repeat 1, the pilot) instead of five times. Its results are reported per attempt, without claims about repeatability. More repeats need a new amendment. Claude Code and Codex keep the protocol's five repeats.
